Prevention: Prune and remove old branches and leaves so as to enhance aeration
Avoid planting host plants such as avocados, guavas, pineapples, citrus, etc.as wind breaks
Improve shade by sparsely planting shade crops such as
Macadamia spp. to encourage natural enemies
Monitoring: Scout immediately after transplanting and later, on a weekly basis
Inspect for presence of shiny pale-green insects on the green wood and leaves (underside) especially along main leaf vein and near tips of green shoots
Institute control measures when 10 or more leaves are infested with one or more scales
Direct Control (Non-chemical): Spray with mineral oils at 200 mls per 20 lts of water
Add 10-15 tablespoons full of liquid soap in 20 lt bucket of water and spray.
Verticillium lecanii to reduce population of scales in the ecosystem
Direct Control (Chemical): Wear protective clothing when handling chemicals
Follow instruction on the product label such as dosage, pre-harvest interval and appropriate time of application
Spray only on the affected plants
Always consult recent list of registered pesticides (PCPB)
Apply with a brush at the base of the stem (1 foot from the base) a 15 cm wide band of a deltamethrin based product such as
EC, Atom 2.5EC etc at the rate of 10-15mls/20L of water mixed with 15gms of
Methylene blue which acts as a marker
Mode of action: pyrethroid with contact and residual activity
Dusbarn 4EC at 50-100ml/20L of water, Bullet 48EC at 40mls/20L of water etc.
Restrictions: WHO II (Moderately hazardous); PHI 3 days; Toxic to aquatic organisms; High risk to bees
Toxic to aquatic organisms, bees and livestock
